grades.main_gap: For n ≥ 2 neither minimax direction is proved: no proof that the geometric Liu configuration resists every Xiang response (LB), and no universal upper bound over all Liu configurations (UB). Only n = 1 is fully determined.
grades.notes: Correct and complete: claim-phase lemma (odd-rank sum), sup/inf reduction with sup-justification, full n=1 case with both directions and attainment, and exact matched-pair construction giving 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1) for one strategy pair. General value remains conjecture supported only by grid/numerical search; the marking-phase minimax arguments are absent.
